newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks pull off peaks in late trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks pull off peaks in late trading.

text.p: U.S. stocks pulled off their session peaks in late trading as investors took some profits heading into the weekend.
Traders said action slowed towards the end of a volatile week on Wall Street.
The Dow was up about 53 points at 7706, off the day's high of 7771. The Nasdaq composite rose about two to 1438.
A firm bond market, investor conviction the Fed will not raise rates next week, and quarter-ending buying supported shares, traders said.
